auditGaps.gap: Front and three-quarter: the fan front is still flat pointed slabs and serrated chevrons with white faceted blade tufts in the cups, a dark slot behind the image-right tuft and thorn spikes along the top edge, so it reads as a crown of leaves and thorns instead of soft shaggy locks with pale fluffy inner tufts.

Side and top: the ear seen from the side is a column of crumpled shard slabs with no pale inner cup (0 vs about 0.15 to 0.2 of ear area), and from above the fan is a thin flat plate, so the cups have no forward depth.

Profile: the eye is a wedge tapering to a point at the bottom with a sliver iris (width/height about 0.35 vs 0.48, iris about 0.3 vs 0.5 of eye width); three-quarter: small centred pupils under a pinched brow give a startled look instead of a gentle sideways glance.
All views: the head carries three idioms (front slabs and blades, rear leaf locks, smooth face) on a completely bare body with no cheek, chest, forearm or calf coat masses.

Back and rear oblique: the head dome is a tall smooth shield outlined by a ragged ledge where the locks stop, reading as a plate set into the wings; locks are hard-edged leaf ellipsoids with a needle fringe on the lower edge and a thorn row on the crown.

Front: the new four digit chains curl under and inward, so the forepaw is a short closed fist with claws clustered at the inner lower corner and a cuff step at the wrist (paw over wrist 1.375 vs about 1.5; posed arm IoU .874 fail); in profile the four lobes and claws do read.

Front and back: square shoulders with deltoid caps over a strongly pinched waist read as an athletic hourglass, and from behind the upper back is a rounded disc framed by dark notches at the shoulder corners; posed trunk IoU .854 fails.

Front: the crown is a lumpy band about level with the ear roots (rise about 0 to 0.01H vs 0.025H) carrying thorn spikes, and the lower face is broad with cheek bulges at the mouth line instead of tapering to a small rounded chin.

Front: each eye is a near-round white disc (height/width about 1.28 vs 1.5) with a small centred pupil (iris about 0.44 vs 0.6 of eye width, no offset) and a uniform outline, so it stares instead of glancing under a heavier upper lid.

Front and side: four equal beads in a straight row with straight cone claws on the toe fronts, and in profile a low slipper with a vertical heel face and no domed instep (posed foot IoU .647 fail); unchanged since 0458.
Front and side: the knee is a lit band over an inner crease rather than a soft kneecap plane, and both posed leg bands fail (thigh .829, shin .643).
Side: the upper arm top is still a pale flat-topped cap with a hard upper edge; the corner round softened only its front corner, so the shoulder juts as a box.
